entities.summary: Pahlavān Mahmoud, known in Iran as Pouryā-ye Vali, was a pahlevani wrestling champion, Sufi teacher and poet from the 14th century Iran, famous for his exceptional strength. He became the patron saint of the city of Khiva, in Uzbekistan.
